items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: people that you might get on Arthur Godfrey's show or something like that.

ctx.x: At that time what was the normal teenager into music-wise?

Well you know you’re going back a long time, you know, but I’m no baby. Like who was big in those days, Bing Crosby, who was the guy that did — oh a lot of romantic singers or people that you might get on Arthur Godfrey’s show or something like that. Of course the one outstanding one is Bing Crosby as far as I was concerned. The Boswell Sisters were coming up, groups of that type.
This is a little off the subject but how did the second World War affect the lives of musicians? Were you able to observe any of that?
